PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<"PY"
import importlib.util,json
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from agentic_payment_experiment import Decision,PaymentStatus
from agentic_payment_experiment.trusted_execution import KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightStatus

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rv_fact",Path("tests/trusted_execution/test_known_payment_attempt.py")); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
f=m.KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightTests(methodName="test_empty_inventory_is_clear_and_primitive_serializable"); f.setUp()
spec2=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rv_gate",Path("tests/test_webshop_runtime_gate.py")); gmod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2); spec2.loader.exec_module(gmod)
g=gmod.WebShopRuntimeGateTest(methodName="test_empty_known_attempt_input_preserves_prior_gate_result"); g.setUp()

unrelated_bad_f=replace(f.succeeded,request_id="other",payment_id="",status="INVALID_STATUS",transaction_object_ref=None,authority_ref=None,agent_ref=None,payee=None)
unknown_f=replace(f.succeeded,request_id=None)
same_bad_f=replace(f.succeeded,payment_id="")
same_ok_f=f.succeeded
unrelated_ok_f=replace(f.succeeded,request_id="other-ok",payment_id="other-pay",transaction_object_ref="other-ok")

unrelated_bad_g=replace(g.execution,request_id="other",payment_id="",status="INVALID_STATUS",transaction_object_ref=None,authority_ref=None,agent_ref=None,payee=None)
unknown_g=replace(g.execution,request_id=None)
same_bad_g=replace(g.execution,payment_id="",status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
same_ok_g=replace(g.execution,payment_id="existing-success",status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
unrelated_ok_g=replace(g.execution,request_id="other-ok",payment_id="other-pay",transaction_object_ref="other-ok",status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)

def gate(inv):
 o,c=g.invoke(governed_action=g.governed_action,known_payment_attempts=inv)
 return {"decision":o.decision.value,"callback":o.callback_count,"calls":c,"preflight":o.known_payment_attempt_preflight_fact.status.value,"fact":o.known_payment_attempt_preflight_fact.to_dict()}
results={}
results["unrelated_malformed"]={"fact":f.derive((unrelated_bad_f,)).to_dict(),"gate":gate((unrelated_bad_g,))}
results["unknown_ownership"]={"fact":f.derive((unknown_f,)).to_dict(),"gate":gate((unknown_g,))}
results["same_malformed"]={"fact":f.derive((same_bad_f,)).to_dict(),"gate":gate((same_bad_g,))}
results["same_succeeded"]={"fact":f.derive((same_ok_f,)).to_dict(),"gate":gate((same_ok_g,))}
for name,finvs,ginvs in [
 ("mixed_blocked",[(unrelated_bad_f,same_ok_f),(same_ok_f,unrelated_bad_f)],[(unrelated_bad_g,same_ok_g),(same_ok_g,unrelated_bad_g)]),
 ("mixed_indeterminate",[(unrelated_ok_f,same_bad_f),(same_bad_f,unrelated_ok_f)],[(unrelated_ok_g,same_bad_g),(same_bad_g,unrelated_ok_g)])]:
 fs=[f.derive(x).to_dict() for x in finvs]; gs=[gate(x) for x in ginvs]; results[name]={"facts":fs,"gates":gs,"order_independent":fs[0]==fs[1] and gs[0]["decision"]==gs[1]["decision"] and gs[0]["callback"]==gs[1]["callback"] and gs[0]["preflight"]==gs[1]["preflight"]}

assert results["unrelated_malformed"]["fact"]["status"]=="CLEAR"
assert results["unrelated_malformed"]["gate"]["decision"]=="ALLOW" and results["unrelated_malformed"]["gate"]["callback"]==1
assert results["unknown_ownership"]["fact"]["status"]=="INDETERMINATE" and results["unknown_ownership"]["gate"]["callback"]==0
assert results["same_malformed"]["fact"]["status"]=="INDETERMINATE" and results["same_malformed"]["gate"]["callback"]==0
assert results["same_succeeded"]["fact"]["status"]=="BLOCKED" and results["same_succeeded"]["gate"]["decision"]=="DENY" and results["same_succeeded"]["gate"]["callback"]==0
assert results["mixed_blocked"]["order_independent"] and results["mixed_blocked"]["facts"][0]["status"]=="BLOCKED"
assert results["mixed_indeterminate"]["order_independent"] and results["mixed_indeterminate"]["facts"][0]["status"]=="INDETERMINATE"
print(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
PY
